pages.text: Inbetween the remains and the flesh of the Risus is Organic Matter - a perfect mix of both. It can also be viewed as the primal form of Risus: a paradoxical fleshy matter that is simultaneously alive, 'existentially burning' and fossilizing. As such, it can be used to mend or propagate other parts of the Risus.
It can be obtained by altering Rotten Flesh or by harvesting it from Offsprings and the Beloved. It can be used as fuel in a furnace, with an Organic Matter Block smelting around 20 items.
